title: Singapore Family Safari and City Lights
alt: Supertrees lit up at Gardens by the Bay in Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Three parks at Mandai in one day is a lot, so we put them late in the trip when the children know the pace.
expert.tip: Pack swimwear for the hotel rooftop. Most families end up back at the pool every afternoon between the big outings.

summary: Six days for a family. The city tour with the SkyPark and Gardens by the Bay, a full day at Universal Studios, Sentosa with the cable car, oceanarium and Wings of Time, then a long Mandai day with Bird Paradise, River Wonders and the Night Safari.
included: Included: 5 nights at the Village Hotel Bugis with daily breakfast; half day city tour; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; the Gardens by the Bay domes with the Jurassic World trail; Universal Studios one day pass; two way cable car sky pass; Singapore Oceanarium; Wings of Time; Bird Paradise; River Wonders; Night Safari with tram ride; 10 private and shared transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to Bugis
Check in and let the children loose in the rooftop pool
Easy first evening at the Bugis street market and food court
Optional: the Rain Vortex at Jewel on the way out of the airport
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the civic district
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark on level 57 for the view across the bay
Cloud Forest, Flower Dome and Jurassic World at Gardens by the Bay
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios across all seven zones
Minion Land and Far Far Away first, the coasters after lunch
Back to the hotel in your own time on the Sentosa Express
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass over the harbour with the port below
Singapore Oceanarium with its open ocean tank and reef galleries
Wings of Time on Siloso beach after dark
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer out to the Mandai reserve
Bird Paradise with its walk through aviaries and keeper talks
River Wonders next door for the giant otters and manatees
Night Safari with a tram ride to finish the day
6: Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

program.name: City, island and three wildlife parks
program.description: Five nights in Bugis with a pool for the afternoons, two island days and a full day at Mandai with the Night Safari to close it.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour past Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the civic district.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The level 57 observation deck above the bay, the Gardens and the towers of the business district.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Cloud Forest with its indoor waterfall, the Flower Dome and the Jurassic World trail under the Supertrees.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A one day pass with Minion Land, Far Far Away, Ancient Egypt and the Sci Fi City coasters.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way ride from Mount Faber over HarbourFront to Sentosa, above the container port.

activities.name: Singapore Oceanarium
activities.description: Sentosa's rebuilt aquarium with an open ocean tank, reef habitats and a research gallery for the children.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: A short beachfront night show of water screens, lasers and fire on Siloso beach.

activities.name: Bird Paradise
activities.description: Eight walk through aviaries at Mandai, from African wetlands to Amazon river birds, with daily keeper talks.

activities.name: River Wonders
activities.description: The river themed Mandai park with giant otters, manatees and a boat ride through the Amazon section.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram circuit through the park after dark, past elephants, rhinos and the cats that only wake at night.
